The '''ruins''' belonged to an ancient village on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spintir/Legends|Spintir]]. They were filled with stone-walled pits and crossed by old tunnels, which served as burial chambers and pantries.<ref name="Mountaintop Rescue" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ruins appear in ''[[Mountaintop Rescue]]'', the adventure in [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Beginner Game]]''.
